question: Should OpenClaw adopt this gateway-local Teams identity, exact-resource authorization model, durable schema, and public `api.teams` plugin surface as permanent core contracts?
rationale: The patch is not only a Workspaces feature; it establishes authentication, authorization, persistence, protocol, device-pairing, agent-delegation, and external plugin contracts whose permanent ownership and acceptable threat model require maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the full architecture
options.body: Approve the core identity, authorization, persistence, protocol, and Plugin SDK direction after the blockers, upgrade proof, and security review are complete.

options.title: Stage a narrower first release
options.body: Keep exact-tab sharing but defer or remove the public plugin API and delegated-agent contracts until those seams are separately approved.

options.title: Pause this implementation
options.body: Keep the linked product issue open but do not merge this branch until maintainers select a different ownership or security boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the full architecture
recommendation.body: Approve the core identity, authorization, persistence, protocol, and Plugin SDK direction after the blockers, upgrade proof, and security review are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision extends the recently merged Workspaces foundation across core gateway, persistence, UI, and public plugin boundaries.
